claims.explanation: AT-7519 is a CDK inhibitor with strongest activity against CDK9 (and CDK1/2/4/6), and its selective killing pattern tracks with dependence on CDK9-driven transcription and intact apoptotic/DNA-damage signaling. Lines with BRAF/PTEN/PIK3CA pathway activation and high CDK9/CCNT1 or MYC-driven transcriptional output are most sensitive, while lines with ABCB1/ABCG2 efflux, RB1 loss, or low CDK9 dependence are protected. The virtual-cell signature (EGR1 up, PCNA/CDK7 down, similarity to alvocidib) supports a CDK9/transcription-elongation mechanism rather than a pure cell-cycle CDK1/2 effect.
